title: Gender Bias Detection in Court Decisions: A Brazilian Case Study
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark was designed to detect gender bias in court decisions and did not measure any aspects related to faith or religion.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on detecting gender bias in legal texts.
